source.note: Dane społecznościowe BattleScribe, bez autoryzacji Games Workshop. Import: tools/import-bsdata.mjs.

187e-9a64-6375-dd86.name: Shield of Faith
187e-9a64-6375-dd86.text: Models with this rule have a 6+ invulnerable save.

d8cb-e309-b18c-9b81.name: Two-handed
d8cb-e309-b18c-9b81.text: It requires two hands to swing a massive weapon, so it can never be used together with another weapon.

f9cf-60e4-df38-d511.name: Draws
f9cf-60e4-df38-d511.text: Due to the ponderous lurching swing required to weild this weapon, the wielder's opponent is likely to catch them on the upswing. If the combat ends in a draw then the wielder's Initiative is halved when working out which fighter wins.

8aea-8a7d-db5a-2098.name: Mighty Blow
8aea-8a7d-db5a-2098.text: The sheer mass of a massive weapon combinedwith the momentum of a charge makes it difficult to retaliate against such an onslaught. If the wielder charged into combat this turn then thier opponent rolls one less Attack dice for the duration of the turn (to a minimum of 1).

9000-7d13-072e-0d70.name: Noisy
9000-7d13-072e-0d70.text: This weapon emits a loud and distinctive sound, so must test to see if the alarm is raised when used during missions such as The Raid.

01dd-939c-b92f-5033.name: Ammo Roll
01dd-939c-b92f-5033.text: The flamer is required to take an Ammo roll each and every time it fires.

56f1-db26-e9e3-5786.name: Combi-Weapon
56f1-db26-e9e3-5786.text: A combi-weapon can be fired either as a boltgun or the other weapon type, but can only be fired as the other weapon once per game. If an Ammo roll is failed for a combi-weapon before the other weapon is fired, then the other weapon can be used once, but the boltgun can no longer be fired. Weapon reloads only apply to the boltgun, and cannot be purchased for the other weapon. Telescopic and red-dot laser sights purchased for a combi-weapon only apply when firing it as a boltgun.

248b-6976-f227-1a11.name: Flamer
248b-6976-f227-1a11.text: The shot is represented by the teardrop-shaped template. This is used as described in the Shooting section (pg 39).

006a-fdfa-c982-3326.name: Psi-shock
006a-fdfa-c982-3326.text: When this weapon is used to target a Grey Knights fighter, a Shadowseer or a Zoanthrope, its Damage characteristic is 3 rather than 1.

42ff-84d7-2345-0c17.name: Redemptive Rage
42ff-84d7-2345-0c17.text: A Sister Repentia always recovers from pinning at the start of your turn, even if there is no friendly fighter within 2". No Initiative test is required.

af8a-da0b-6c4d-641b.name: Spirit of the Martyr
af8a-da0b-6c4d-641b.text: When you use your kill team's Light of the Emperor rule, do not re-roll Attack rolls of 1 for a Sister Repentia. Instead, she gets a 3+ invulnerable save until the end of the phase.

4076-9e49-1a96-1990.name: Hand of the Emperor
4076-9e49-1a96-1990.text: When you use your kill team's Light of the Emperor rule, do not re-roll Attack rolls of 1 for a Celestian. Instead, she gets a +2 combat modifier (instead of a +1 modifier) if she charged this turn.

0bf1-9354-2dfe-0320.name: Angelic Visage
0bf1-9354-2dfe-0320.text: You can re-roll failed invulnerable saves for this model.

c298-9376-64cc-9e0b.name: Gunfighter
c298-9376-64cc-9e0b.text: This fighter can use two pistols at once, granting her an extra shooting attack when she shoots, following the usual rules. She can only use this extra attack when armed with a pistol in each hand, and when she does so she cannot use the Crack Shot or Fast Shot skills.

277f-a95a-1233-66ac.name: The Emperor's Deliverance
277f-a95a-1233-66ac.text: When you use your kill team's Light of the Emperor rule, do not re-roll To Hit rolls or Attack rolls of 1 for a Seraphim. Instead, you can re-roll failed wound rolls for her attacks until the end of the phase.

765f-883f-26a0-b8ae.name: Dual-handed
765f-883f-26a0-b8ae.text: A dual-handed weapon can be wielded in one hand using the profile above. Alternatively a fighter can wield a dual-handed weapon with both hands, in which case it confers a further +1 bonus to their Strength.

c3ee-1366-3e6e-a25c.name: Extra Weapon
c3ee-1366-3e6e-a25c.text: The fighter can use the servo-arm in addition to any other weapons they use in hand-to-hand combat. When they do so, they roll an extra Attack dice. However, only one hit in each hand-to-hand phase can be caused by the servo-arm.

3c8c-8433-1dd0-34d5.name: Ripper Blade
3c8c-8433-1dd0-34d5.text: A ripper gun can be used in the hand-to-hand phase as a knife.

0da4-d8d9-35f0-e557.name: Large Blast
0da4-d8d9-35f0-e557.text: This weapon uses the large blast template.

4515-abd2-90c9-b3a5.name: Soothe Machine Spirit
4515-abd2-90c9-b3a5.text: You can choose to re-roll any failed Ammo rolls for fighters within 6" of a friendly Tech-Priest Enginseer.

5b76-d842-4150-ac9f.name: Fear Me, But Follow
5b76-d842-4150-ac9f.text: Any friendly fighter within 6"  of a Commissar can use the Commissar's Leadership characteristic when taking break tests and test to see if the fighter recovers their nerve when broken. In addition, any friendly fighters within 6" of the Commissar can use the Commissar's Initiative characteristic when testing to escape pinning early. Finally, a kill team with a Commissar automatically passes any bottle tests (whether you want it to or not!). A Commissar cannot confer these benefits if they are down or broken.

a65c-40a7-f7d8-049d.name: Unreliable
a65c-40a7-f7d8-049d.text:
When a 6 is rolled To Hit for one of these weapons then an Ammo roll is required (pg 36)

If an Ammo roll results in a 2 then the weapon is useless for the rest of the game (as a 2 will ineviably fail) but the weapon explodes.

If an unreliable weapon's Ammo roll rating is 'Auto' then it automatically fails an Ammo roll so none is taken. However, roll 2D6 anyway - the weapon explodes on a roll of 2.

An Exploding weapon inflicts an automatic hit on the user as if they were struck by their own weapon but with a Strength value of 1 less than normal. In case of weapons that use templates, no template is used: the blast in confined solely to the firing fighter.

7fd7-32cf-07f7-5e36.name: Prodigious Power
7fd7-32cf-07f7-5e36.text: Generate a Muscle skill (pg 106) for an Ogryn when you muster your kill team.

6c17-bbe3-49aa-4165.name: Bounty
6c17-bbe3-49aa-4165.text: If an Ogryn is down or out of action at the end of a mission, the enemy kill team secures an additional promethium cache.

8ed8-d983-0f23-96d5.name: Crack Shot
8ed8-d983-0f23-96d5.text: When you roll an Injury roll for a shooting attack made by a Militarum Tempestus Scion, you can re-roll the dice. Note that this only applies when making the initial Injury roll for the shooting attack. Injurt rolls made during the recovery phase follow all of the normal rules instead.

c601-835d-5517-d668.name: Ammo
c601-835d-5517-d668.text: Grenades must be specially modified in order for them to be fired from a launcher, so the grenades purchased for a grenade launcher cannot be thrown during a game. Likewise, grenades not allocated to the launcher cannot be fired from it.

8d90-1a07-2a40-aa55.name: Demolition
8d90-1a07-2a40-aa55.text: This weapon can be attached to a stationary structure as explained in the rules for attacking terrain (pg 49).

1438-796f-4f40-26b9.name: Unwieldy
1438-796f-4f40-26b9.text: A krak grenade is a heavy and cumbersome grenade with a concentrated blast. It is therefore harder to hit a target with a krak grenade than with other grenades and a -1 to hit modifier is imposed when throwing one. This modifier doesn't apply to krak grenades fired from a grenade laucnher.

828b-3b5b-d8e3-6bfb.name: Booby Traps
828b-3b5b-d8e3-6bfb.text: After both kill teams have deployed, but before the game begins, choose one piece of terrain no greater than 12" in any dimension. Roll a dice each time an enemy fighter makes a move that takes them into, through, or out of that piece of terrain. On a roll of 1, that fighter sustains an automatic Strength 6 hit. If this hit wounds the fighter, it inflicts 1 wound. Saving throws can be taken, though with a -3 save modifier. A fighter who suffers such a hit without going down or out of action is pinned.

628e-ffe6-332c-50bc.name: Charmed Life
628e-ffe6-332c-50bc.text: Sly Marbo has a 5+ invulnerable save and can never be pinned.

9e35-ebd4-68b1-ffb7.name: Like a Shadow
9e35-ebd4-68b1-ffb7.text: If Sly Marbo is down at the start of your turn, he recovers automatically and can act normally that turn. In addition, he can move 5" when he makes a follow-up move.

9cd4-ce48-e57a-42e3.name: Lone Operative
9cd4-ce48-e57a-42e3.text: In a campaign, this model can only be used in Lone Operative games.

ae27-ba42-01fc-c580.name: Fearless
ae27-ba42-01fc-c580.text: A model with this special rule automatically passes fear and terror tests.

e66d-589c-6197-2131.name: Infiltration
e66d-589c-6197-2131.text: Once both kill teams have been set up, but before a mission begins, you may make two free run moves with each model with this special rule. They may not do anything during these moves except run, and they may not move within 8" of an enemy.

d6a7-8f68-11d6-bf0a.name: Parry
d6a7-8f68-11d6-bf0a.text: Fighters with swords are able to parry

bad7-5210-19f2-5530.name: Toxic
bad7-5210-19f2-5530.text:
No To Wound roll is required when a target is hit with this weapon: if the target is hit then the toxins will automatically inflict 1 wound. Armour may still save a target as normal. Note this only applies against living targets. if this weapon hits an unliving target, then a normal To Wound roll must be made using the Strength showin in the profile.

A target suffering their final wound from this weapon does not roll on the standard injury table. Instead, roll on the table below both when the injury is inflicted and in subsequent recovery phases. (See page 57 of Shadow War: Armageddon rule book)

0908-d389-d16e-10e2.name: Silent
0908-d389-d16e-10e2.text: This weapon emits no noise so when fired doesn't test to sound the alarm during missions such as The Raid.

5940-6fbc-da96-957a.name: Poisonous
5940-6fbc-da96-957a.text: Blight grenades always wound fighters on a 4+, regardless of their T, unless a lower result would be required.

0533-6361-f4c0-00d9.name: Concussive
0533-6361-f4c0-00d9.text: A fighter who goes down as a result of an injury roll made for this weapon is automatically taken out of action, even if the wielder is fighting other opponents

63a6-d1a0-f488-0189.name: Flailing Attack
63a6-d1a0-f488-0189.text: Enemy fighters cannot parry against a fighter that is attacking with a flail.

3a17-03c8-50ab-5cc7.name: Rare Ammunition
3a17-03c8-50ab-5cc7.text: A fighter equipped with a weapon reload cannot re-roll a failed Ammo roll for their inferno bolts - the re-roll only applies to the first failed ammo roll they make for their weapon's standard ammunition.

08f7-9a82-3917-de79.name: Bounty
08f7-9a82-3917-de79.text: If a Chaos Terminator is down or out of action at the end of a mission, the enemy kill team secures an additional promethium cache.

46c9-a573-9e4d-5a99.name: Shapeless Abomination
46c9-a573-9e4d-5a99.text: Before moving or attacking with a Chaos Spawn, randomly generate their characteristics as appropriate.

b6fd-dd91-ba4b-a611.name: Anti-Reality Wave
b6fd-dd91-ba4b-a611.text: The D-Scythe's shot is represented by the teardrop-shaped flamer template.

c7ab-b861-3d87-47b7.name: Battle Focus
c7ab-b861-3d87-47b7.text: If a fighter with this rule does not move in the movement phase, they may choose to make a normal move immediately after firing in the shooting phase. This may not be a run or charge move.

08e8-4d42-e0b4-5c5a.name: Soulrazor
08e8-4d42-e0b4-5c5a.text: A fighter wounded by this weapon must pass a Leadership test or be immediately taken out of action.

dcee-543e-59ff-fc44.name: Missile Ammunition
dcee-543e-59ff-fc44.text: An Eldar missile launcher is supplied with multiple ammunition types. If an Ammo roll is failed then the missile launcher and any ammunition it has cannot be used for the rest of the mission.

1003-da3e-08a4-46a1.name: Heavy Weapon Platform
1003-da3e-08a4-46a1.text: If your Craftworld Eldar kill team contains a Heavy Weapon Platform, it must be allocated to a Guardian Defender Gunner at the start of each mission. If the Gunner moves in any way, place the platform anywhere within 2" of the Gunner at the end of the move. The Gunner may fire the weapon instead of any other weapons they carry, drawing line of sight from the platform itself. The platform does not count as a fighter for any rules purposes, and may not otherwise be interacted with in any way, though it does block line of sight. If the platform would get in the way of any other models (e.g. charging fighters), simply move it out of the way. If the Gunner is taken out of action, or otherwise removed from play, the Heavy Weapon Platform is also removed, but is not permanently removed from your kill team if that Gunner subsequently dies.

3daa-11de-18d3-c769.name: Paired
3daa-11de-18d3-c769.text: A fighter using a pair of Ghostswords may re-roll failed To Wound rolls in hand-to-hand combat.

34a5-249d-ed7e-30cc.name: Independent Fire
34a5-249d-ed7e-30cc.text: A fighter armed with this weapon may fire twice. These shots may be made against different targets.

d3b4-7682-69cf-7838.name: Iron Will
d3b4-7682-69cf-7838.text: The fighter can re-roll any failed Leadership tests – break tests, fear tests and so on. If the fighter's Leadership is being used for a bottle test then you can re-roll it if it is failed.

e4b9-9cff-b75b-c3f7.name: Unshakeable
e4b9-9cff-b75b-c3f7.text: A fighter housed within a wraithbone construct cannot be pinned by shooting attacks, unless they are from high-impact weapons.

2c65-3068-ba45-f752.name: Excruciating Agony
2c65-3068-ba45-f752.text: A fighter who goes down as a result of an Injury roll made for this weapon is automatically taken out of action, even if the wielder is fighting other opponents.

9332-043f-197d-be70.name: Flexible (Chainhook)
9332-043f-197d-be70.text: Opposing fighters may not parry against a fighter armed with a chainhook.

7fcc-f152-9f5e-8077.name: Lethal
7fcc-f152-9f5e-8077.text: A fighter may re-roll To Wound rolls with this weapon.

56fb-3aec-fcfe-ce29.name: Gladiatorial Weapon
56fb-3aec-fcfe-ce29.text: Items of equipment from the Gladiatorial Weapons list count as hand-to-hand weapons in all regards. In addition they take up both of a fighter’s hands, so may not be used in combination with any other weapons, and count as two weapons for the purposes of the fighting with two weapons rule.

c0da-9eab-29cc-6266.name: Flexible (Razorflails)
c0da-9eab-29cc-6266.text: Opposing fighters may not parry against a fighter armed with a chainhook. In addition, the fighter can re-roll To Wound rolls in the hand-to-hand phase.

cc2f-b9c5-f807-a18f.name: Entangled
cc2f-b9c5-f807-a18f.text: The fighter may use their shardnet against one close combat opponent at the start of the hand-to-hand phase. The fighter must take an Initiative test. If they pass the test then they entangle their opponent's weapons – their opponent must fight using only a knife in this phase.

5ef0-e4a9-d7f0-8218.name: Poisoned
5ef0-e4a9-d7f0-8218.text: This weapon will always wound enemy fighters on a 4+, regardless of their Toughness.

74f8-bfdd-2330-b202.name: Champion of the Arena
74f8-bfdd-2330-b202.text: If a Succubus is attacked by multiple opponents in hand-to-hand combat, she uses their numbers against them. The enemy fighters don’t gain the multiple combat bonuses to their Attacks and Combat Score.

68b5-bcda-b2bf-812d.name: Master Alchemist
68b5-bcda-b2bf-812d.text: If your kill team includes a Haemonculus, you may roll 2 dice on the combat drugs table and apply both results.

067f-182f-292f-d6b2.name: Multi-Limbed Horror
067f-182f-292f-d6b2.text: A Haemonculus may roll one extra Attack dice in hand-to-hand combat. In addition, a Haemonculus causes fear.

9032-cf1e-f9a6-d454.name: Evade
9032-cf1e-f9a6-d454.text: Any enemy shooting at a Scourge from short range suffers a -2 To Hit modifier, while any enemy shooting at long range suffers a -1 modifier. This penalty only applies if the fighter is in the open and is not benefitting from a cover modifier.

de8c-16f0-bedb-6b6f.name: Winged Killer
de8c-16f0-bedb-6b6f.text: A Scourge may use its wings in the movement phase instead of moving normally. The Scourge may move up to 12" in any direction, ignoring the normal restrictions for terrain, however you may not end this move in impassable ground. The Scourge may use this move to charge an enemy fighter, but does not double its movement distance when doing so.

2159-0ddd-821c-4244.name: Sycthing Strikes
2159-0ddd-821c-4244.text: A fighter attacking with a Metamorph talon adds 1 to its Weapon Skill in hand-to-hand combat; a model attacking with two Metamorph talons has a +2 bonus to its Weapon Skill in hand-to-hand combat instead.

899f-b5c6-2f49-3456.name: Entangling Lash
899f-b5c6-2f49-3456.text: When attacking with a Metamorph whip, you can force one enemy model in hand-to-hand combat with this model to roll one less Attack dice (to a minimum of 1).

c67b-f958-781a-5116.name: Claw
c67b-f958-781a-5116.text: A fighter attacking with a rending claw cannot carry anything else in that hand. If the fighter is attacking with two rending claws, they can re-roll To Wound rolls in the hand-to-hand phase.

f1d9-c2fd-2a97-685e.name: Ammo Roll
f1d9-c2fd-2a97-685e.text: The hand flamer is required to take an Ammo roll each and every time it fires or is used in hand-to-hand combat.

899a-20ae-c105-50a4.name: Webbed
899a-20ae-c105-50a4.text: If this weapon hits its target, the victim is automatically webbed – no rolls are made for wounds or injuries and no saving roll is allowed for armour. A webbed target can attempt to struggle free at the start of each of their turns. To do so, roll a D6 and add the model's Strength; if the total is 8 or more, the victim frees itself and may act normally that turn. If the total is less than 8 then the victim remains trapped and immediately suffers 1 wound (though armour saves may be taken as normal against this wound). Webbed fighters may not move under any circumstances, and may not shoot; if they are engaged in hand-to-hand combat, they can only ever roll one Attack dice and always count as encumbered.

434b-cfe7-15a9-c46c.name: Brood Command
434b-cfe7-15a9-c46c.text: Any fighter within 12" of their kill team's Neophyte Leader can use their Leadership characteristic when taking break tests and tests to see if they recover their nerve when broken. In addition, any fighters within 12" of their kill team’s Neophyte Leader can use their Initiative characteristic when testing to escape pinning early.

9f2f-1646-e30f-3cb7.name: Spotlight
9f2f-1646-e30f-3cb7.text: Add 1 to the wearer’s Initiative characteristic when determining the distance they automatically spot a hidden enemy. For example, a Neophyte Hybrid with an Initiative characteristic of 4 will automatically spot all hidden enemy fighters within 5" of them.

17a6-9555-0856-7194.name: Unweildy
17a6-9555-0856-7194.text: Although powerful, blasting charges are essentially improvised weapons. It is therefore harder to hit a target with a blasting charge than with a dedicated grenade, and a -1 To Hit modifier is imposed when throwing one.

8023-6a6b-09c0-1710.name: Sneak Up
8023-6a6b-09c0-1710.text: Halve the distance at which an Acolyte Hybrid is spotted when in hiding. For example, if an enemy would normally spot this fighter when within 3", they can only spot an Acolyte Hybrid when within 1½".

2130-0706-835a-4927.name: Berserk Charge
2130-0706-835a-4927.text: A Hybrid Metamorph’s combat modifier for charging is +2, rather than +1.

7c30-d45b-34bd-7a29.name: Bounty
7c30-d45b-34bd-7a29.text: If a Purestrain Genestealer is down or out of action at the end of a mission, the enemy kill team secures an additional promethium cache.

ec04-ad8d-8120-b64c.name: Hyper-reflexes
ec04-ad8d-8120-b64c.text: Purestrain Genestealers have a 5+ invulnerable save.

ee35-82af-578b-dc33.name: Preternatural Agility
ee35-82af-578b-dc33.text: Purestrain Genestealers may triple their movement rate when they run or charge, rather than doubling it as normal. In addition, if Purestrain Genestealers jump across a gap, they jump 3+D3" rather than D6". They can use the full distance rolled, even if they do not have sufficient movement remaining to do so.

2f46-4f02-5af7-6b7b.name: Unstoppable Killer
2f46-4f02-5af7-6b7b.text: Purestrain Genestealers cannot be pinned by shooting attacks, unless they are from high-impact weapons.

5214-29d8-2cb3-3f0a.name: Paired
5214-29d8-2cb3-3f0a.text: A fighter attacking with these weapons can re-roll To Wound rolls in the hand-to-hand phase.

8711-28e8-ef2f-2eab.name: Ward
8711-28e8-ef2f-2eab.text: A fighter with a Nemesis warding stave has a 3+ invulnerable save in hand-to-hand combat.

241b-39e0-9944-556f.name: Bounty
241b-39e0-9944-556f.text:
If a Grey Knight Terminator is down or out of action at the end of a mission, the enemy kill team secures an
additional promethium cache.

ba64-6d7d-4080-0b3e.name: Psychic Abilities
ba64-6d7d-4080-0b3e.text: A Grey Knight Terminator has the Hammerhand psychic ability.

bb47-0806-de0e-4d20.name: Premium Bounty
bb47-0806-de0e-4d20.text: If a Paladin is down or out of action at the end of a mission, the enemy kill team secures an additional D3 promethium caches.

c549-6f57-74d9-0594.name: Psychic Abilities
c549-6f57-74d9-0594.text: A Paladin has the Hammerhand and Purge Soul psychic abilities.

b3d6-3ca5-e78f-1d7d.name: Rare Ammunition
b3d6-3ca5-e78f-1d7d.text: A fighter equipped with a weapon reload cannot re-roll a failed Ammo roll for their psybolts – the re-roll only applies to the first failed Ammo roll they make for their storm bolter’s standard ammunition.

0d37-83ec-d167-e3f7.name: Psychic Ability
0d37-83ec-d167-e3f7.text: You must first pass a Leadership test. If the test is passed, resolve the Psychic Ability. If the test is failed, you cannot use this power this turn, though he can still fire a ranged weapon as normal. However, if you roll a double 6 for this test, the model cannot shoot any ranged weapons this turn either.

09ef-22a1-223c-d199.name: Caress of Death
09ef-22a1-223c-d199.text: A Harlequin’s caress always wounds enemy fighters on a 4+, regardless of their Toughness, unless a lower result would be required.

1813-3964-bed9-5396.name: Embrace of Death
1813-3964-bed9-5396.text: On a turn in which a fighter with a Harlequin’s embrace charges, it confers a +3 bonus to their Strength.

1727-6285-bd82-6ae0.name: Kiss of Death
1727-6285-bd82-6ae0.text: A Harlequin's Kiss uses the standard profile; however, any To Wound rolls of 6 made for a Harlequin's Kiss are resolved using the Kiss of Death profile instead.

69c8-0167-b796-4ea0.name: Mental Assault
69c8-0167-b796-4ea0.text: When rolling To Wound with a miststave, use the winner's Leadership as the attack's Strength characteristic, and the losing fighter's Leadership characteristic as their Toughness. No armour saving throws can be taken against wounds inflicted in this manner.

f3fb-0c67-d0ea-d1f6.name: Neural Onslaught
f3fb-0c67-d0ea-d1f6.text: A neuro disruptor always wounds enemy fighters on a 2+, regardless of their Toughness. No armour saving throws can be taken against wounds inflicted in this manner.

56fd-d775-0ea6-31e3.name: Bio-explosion
56fd-d775-0ea6-31e3.text: Shrieker rounds always wound enemy fighters on a 2+, regardless of their Toughness.

5bb7-1591-7005-5337.name: Shrieker Cannon
5bb7-1591-7005-5337.text: Each time a Death Jester fires a shrieker cannon, pick one of the two profiles to use. If he runs out of one type of ammunition, he may still continue to fire the other type of ammunition with his shrieker cannon.

f8f2-789c-9aaa-a42a.name: Blinding
f8f2-789c-9aaa-a42a.text: Enemy fighters that are hit by a prismatic grenade suffer a -1 penalty to their WS and BS characteristics (to a minimum of 1) until the end of their next turn.

7101-2795-f334-5b04.name: Hallucinogenic
7101-2795-f334-5b04.text: Enemy fighters that are pinned by a hallucinogen grenade launcher suffer a -2 penalty to their Initiative when testing to recover early from pinning.

c4a3-08b4-a4d7-ecb4.name: Prismatic Blur
c4a3-08b4-a4d7-ecb4.text: If a fighter with this ability ran in their previous movement phase, enemy fighters suffer a -2 hit modifier instead of only -1. In addition, a fighter with this ability cannot be pinned by shooting attacks, unless they are from high-impact weapons.

30c4-2cd1-958e-9f1d.name: Death is Not Enough
30c4-2cd1-958e-9f1d.text: If an enemy fighter is pinned by a Death Jester's shrieker cannon, they must immediately take a Leadership test. If this test is passed, the fighter is pinned as normal; if the test is failed, you can move the fighter D6" in any direction (this can even cause them to fall off the edge of a terrain feature!), after which they are pinned as normal.

c442-8fae-3303-8351.name: Bounty
c442-8fae-3303-8351.text: If a Death Jester is down or out of action at the end of a mission, the enemy kill team secures an additional promethium cache.

d139-689f-d5d5-fae7.name: Phantasmancer
d139-689f-d5d5-fae7.text: Enemy fighters must subtract 8" from the maximum range of any shooting attacks they make that are directed at a Shadowseer or a friendly Harlequin Troupe fighter within 6" of him.

ae09-9b59-bf0b-5050.name: Bounty
ae09-9b59-bf0b-5050.text: If a Shadowseer is down or out of action at the end of a mission, the enemy kill team secures an additional promethium cache.

76f9-7424-a244-db8e.name: Impossible Form
76f9-7424-a244-db8e.text: A Solitaire has a 3+ invulnerable save and can never be pinned.

6031-f7f4-7493-97e8.name: The Path of Damnation
6031-f7f4-7493-97e8.text: If you expend a promethium cache to hire a Solitaire, he is the only model you can use for the duration of that mission!The Solitaire counts as your kill team’s leader for all rules purposes when playing the mission.

4609-ad00-9206-7907.name: Premium Bounty
4609-ad00-9206-7907.text:
If a Solitaire is down or out of action at the end of a mission, the enemy kill team secures an additional
D3 promethium caches.

7a65-6872-fb1f-e12b.name: Lashing Blows
7a65-6872-fb1f-e12b.text: Opposing fighters may not parry against a fighter armed with an arco-flail.

c971-6001-ac9f-4b72.name: Combi-Weapon
c971-6001-ac9f-4b72.text: A combi-weapon can be fired either as a boltgun or the other weapon type, but can only be fired as the other weapon once per game. If an Ammo roll is failed for a combi-weapon before the other weapon is fired, then the other weapon can be used once, but the boltgun can no longer be fired. Weapon reloads only apply to the boltgun, and cannot be purchased for the other weapon. Telescopic and red-dot laser sights purchased for a combi-weapon only apply when firing it as a boltgun.

93bf-dca5-80c1-e5b4.name: Rad Sickness
93bf-dca5-80c1-e5b4.text: Each time a fighter suffers an unsaved wound from a rad grenade but is not taken out of action, subtract 1 from their Toughness (to a minimum of 1) for the rest of the game.

014a-d96e-dd30-e2c6.name: Berserk Charge
014a-d96e-dd30-e2c6.text: An Arco-flagellant's combat modifier for charging is +2, rather than +1.

fa1b-0b15-c1a0-ab7a.name: Insensate to Pain
fa1b-0b15-c1a0-ab7a.text:
Arco-flagellants cannot be pinned by shooting attacks, unless they are from high-impact weapons. In addition, use the following table instead of the usual one when making an Injury roll for an Arco-flagellant in the recovery phase:

1-3 Flesh Wound
4-5 Down
6 Out of Action

dc4a-b3e1-ef2b-a86c.name: Uncanny Reflexes
dc4a-b3e1-ef2b-a86c.text: Death Cult Assassins have a 5+ invulnerable save.

33bc-b51e-8fe4-1a97.name: Silent
33bc-b51e-8fe4-1a97.text: This weapon emits no noise so when fired doesn't test to sound the alarm during missions such as The Raid.

dc7a-1736-aa85-cd34.name: Claw
dc7a-1736-aa85-cd34.text: A fighter armed with a lightning claw cannot carry anything else in that hand. If the fighter has two lightning claws, they can re-roll To Wound rolls in the hand-to-hand phase.

4a82-4eee-67e0-ffcd.name: Ethereal Interception
4a82-4eee-67e0-ffcd.text:
A Deathmark is not deployed with the rest of your kill team in any scenario. Instead, before deployment, select a single enemy fighter. In the movement phase of your second turn you may place the Deathmark anywhere on the board within 8" of this model. This counts as its movement for this turn. You may not place the Deathmark in base-to-base contact with any enemy fighters.

 If the Deathmark is arriving in a scenario as reinforcements, it may use this special rule on the turn it arrives as if it were the second turn.

f377-aab5-592b-e5ab.name: Energy Blast
f377-aab5-592b-e5ab.text: A rod of covenant may also be used as a ranged weapon with the Energy Blast profile.

d456-2403-f423-d86e.name: Gauss
d456-2403-f423-d86e.text: You can re-roll failed To Wound rolls for shots fired from this weapon.

b647-c588-60c9-5585.name: Lychguard
b647-c588-60c9-5585.text: If a Lychguard is within 2" of your leader when he is the target of a shooting attack, you may roll a dice. On a 3+, the Lychguard intercepts the shot, and it is resolved against him instead. You may not do this against weapons which use the teardrop-shaped flamer template.

591f-7616-f99b-af82.name: Medic
591f-7616-f99b-af82.text: As long as the Painboy didn't go out of action, you can re-roll a Serious Injury roll for one fighter after a mission.

f63f-4178-a7d8-d335.name: Wardok
f63f-4178-a7d8-d335.text: Fighters within 3" of a friendly Painboy subtract 2 from their recovery phase Injury rolls to a minimum of 1 (including injuries caused by toxic weapons or toxic rounds). In addition, fighters within 6" of a friendly Painboy can use the Painboy's Initiative characteristic when testing to escape pinning early, as long as the Painboy is not down or broken.

7e6a-3f32-6d93-c77c.name: Mekaniak
7e6a-3f32-6d93-c77c.text: Fighters within 3" of a friendly Mek can re-roll failed Ammo rolls.

d2ae-9b50-246a-b2e4.name: Armourer
d2ae-9b50-246a-b2e4.text: If the Mek was deployed, you can re-roll the first failed Ammo roll in the mission (regardless of which fighter's weapon is being rolling for).

98b4-89a0-ad46-ca63.name: Mad Grot
98b4-89a0-ad46-ca63.text: If the Runtherd is only accompanied by a single Gretchin, its a particularly mean one! Add 1 to the Gretchin's Attacks characteristic.

a555-42d0-8d2c-e429.name: Useless Grots
a555-42d0-8d2c-e429.text: Gretchin are considered to be new recruits - thier presence is in no way encouraging.

a5ae-d17e-fbc1-5a8c.name: Scavengers
a5ae-d17e-fbc1-5a8c.text: As long as the Runtherd didn't go out of action, after a mission you have 50 extra points to spend on your Recruit or Rearm action.

ba06-3444-f666-093d.name: Gotcha
ba06-3444-f666-093d.text: Instead of attacking in the hand-to-hand phase, if this fighter is in base-to-base contact with an enemy model, the fighter can take a Strength test at the beginning of the phase. If they are successful, their opponent can only roll a single Attack dice in any combat until the end of the phase.

061e-6823-5871-eb2b.name: Keepin' Order
061e-6823-5871-eb2b.text: Gretchin withing 3" of a friendly fighter armed with this weapon re-roll any failed Leadership tests of any kind, unless the weilder is broken or down.

da40-00ae-bb75-15cd.name: Crack Shot
da40-00ae-bb75-15cd.text: When you roll an Injury roll for a shooting attack made by a Flash Git, you can re-roll the dice. Note that this only applies when making the initial Injury roll for the shooting attack. Injury rolls made during the recovery phase follow all of the normal rules instead.

2a11-ee40-f04c-b7b5.name: Unshakeable
2a11-ee40-f04c-b7b5.text: A fighter wearing Terminator armour cannot be pinned by shooting attacks, unless they are from high-impact weapons.

32e0-23ba-673a-0f4d.name: Sniper Weapon
32e0-23ba-673a-0f4d.text: A sniper rifle takes time to set up and use. Because of this, a fighter cannot fire a sniper rifle if they moved that turn.

67ce-672f-12fd-1ac2.name: One Use Only
67ce-672f-12fd-1ac2.text: A model with a demolition charge can use it once per mssion. After it has been used it cannot be used again. You cannot take wepaon reloads for a demolition charge.

f925-adb1-2dcf-8b1c.name: Unshakeable Focus
f925-adb1-2dcf-8b1c.text: A Vindicare Assassin does not have to shoot at the closest enemy.

d109-b7e3-8a92-c93c.name: Lightning Relflexes
d109-b7e3-8a92-c93c.text: A model with this special rule has a 4+ invulnerable save and can never be pinned.

c9ef-f491-3b1a-7174.name: Exitus Ammo
c9ef-f491-3b1a-7174.text:
Each time a Vindicare Assassin fires this weapon (including in hand-to-hand combat), choose one of the three following types of ammunition and apply the chosen ammunition’s rules to that shot:

Shield-breaker - Invulnerable saves cannot be taken against this shot.
Turbo-penetrator - This shot has a Damage characteristic of D3, rather than 1.
Hellfire - When making a To Wound roll for this shot, a roll of 2+ is successful unless the target is unliving, in which case the weapon's Strength characteristic is used as normal.

2ada-a464-f8fd-8fef.name: Sprint
2ada-a464-f8fd-8fef.text: An Eversor Assassin may triple their movement rate when they run or charge, rather than doubling it as normal.

41a9-0f7e-f155-cc5d.name: Bio-meltdown
41a9-0f7e-f155-cc5d.text: When an Eversor Assassin is taken out of action, before they are removed from the battlefield, each fighter within 1" suffers an automatic Strength 5 hit. If this hit wounds a fighter, it inflicts 1 wound. Saves can be taken against any wounds caused, but have a -2 modifier. If, as a result of this rule, there are no fighters left on the battlefield (other than downed fighters) the Eversor Assassin's player wins the mission, regardless of any other conditions. Otherwise, the Eversor Assassin's player loses the mission, regardless of any other conditions.

1339-9fd6-ff93-f161.name: Executioner Pistol
1339-9fd6-ff93-f161.text: An Eversor Assassin can choose to fire either bolt pistol rounds or needle pistol rounds each time they fire this weapon. If an ammo roll is failed for one of the kinds of rounds, the Eversor Assassin can still fire the other kind of round.

0af8-dc48-b7ad-f099.name: Transonic
0af8-dc48-b7ad-f099.text: On a wound roll of 6, the save modifier of this weapon changes to -4

7692-70d0-8713-649d.name: Phosphor
7692-70d0-8713-649d.text: A model that suffers a hit from a phosphor pistol cannot hide in its next turn.

58d6-ac18-ab3b-9d7e.name: Volatile
58d6-ac18-ab3b-9d7e.text: A plasma caliver has the potential to overheat, and may explode. (see Shadow War: Armageddon, pg 48).

c8ad-3634-515d-b195.name: Taser
c8ad-3634-515d-b195.text: Add +2 to your combat score if your opponent fumbles, instead of the usual +1.

0675-3ffe-8437-f716.name: Sniper Weapon
0675-3ffe-8437-f716.text: A transuranic arquebus takes time to set up and use. Because of this, a fighter cannot fire a transuranic arquebus if they moved that turn.

5339-7c56-c037-9ac7.name: Combat Master
5339-7c56-c037-9ac7.text: If a Sicarian Ruststalker is attacked by multiple opponents in hand-to-hand combat, it uses their numbers against them. The enemy fighters don't gain the multiple combat bonuses to their Attacks and Combat Score.

3f1e-e929-bd15-a786.name: Infiltration
3f1e-e929-bd15-a786.text: Once both kill teams have been set up, but before a mission begins, you may make two free run moves with this fighter. They may not do anything during these moves except run, and they may not move within 8" of an enemy.

2862-b8cf-2a45-2783.name: Neurostatic Aura
2862-b8cf-2a45-2783.text: Fighters within 6" of any enemy Sicarian Infiltrators subtract 1 from their Initiative and Leadership characteristics.

671d-789c-ab74-3b80.name: Soothe Machine Spirit
671d-789c-ab74-3b80.text: You can choose to re-roll any failed Ammo rolls for fighters within 6" of a friendly Tech-Priest Enginseer.

0e65-119d-0078-85e9.name: Field Medic
0e65-119d-0078-85e9.text: Fighters within 3" of a friendly Apothecary subtract 2 from their recovery phase Injury rolls to a minimum of 1 (including rolls for injuries caused by toxic rounds). In addition, after the battle, you can choose to re-roll any Serious Injury rolls.

ed21-2b77-b584-fffd.name: Bounty
ed21-2b77-b584-fffd.text: If a Space Marine Terminator is down or out of action at the end of a mission, then enemy kill team secures an additional promethium cache.

c933-509f-f7cd-e113.name: Xenos Hunter
c933-509f-f7cd-e113.text: When attacking Ork fighters with a Deathwatch Veteran in hand-to-hand combat, you score critical hits on rolls of 5 or 6 instead of 6.

2348-237e-5bbb-8656.name: Silent
2348-237e-5bbb-8656.text: This weapon emits no noise so when fired doesn't test to sound the alarm during missions such as The Raid.

f5cd-1211-8568-c7da.name: Bonding Knife Ritual
f5cd-1211-8568-c7da.text: Any fighter within 12" of their kill team’s Pathfinder Shas’ui can use their Leadership characteristic when taking break tests and tests to see if they recover their nerve when broken. In addition, any fighters within 12" of their kill team’s Pathfinder Shas’ui may test to recover from pinning as if they were within 2" of a friendly fighter.

1252-a784-01c0-9dcc.name: Infiltration
1252-a784-01c0-9dcc.text: Once both kill teams have been set up, but before a mission begins, you may make two free run moves with a Stealth Team Shas’ui. They may not do anything during these moves except run, and they may not move within 8" of an enemy.

45c5-afe8-2835-5ed9.name: Stealth Field
45c5-afe8-2835-5ed9.text: A Stealth Team Shas’ui always counts as being in cover, even when in the open. This may not be negated or ignored by any special rules which reduce or ignore cover

a641-5a0c-9967-4dba.name: Direct Fire
a641-5a0c-9967-4dba.text: In your shooting phase, you may pick a friendly Tau Pathfinder fighter (but not a Drone) within 6" of a Cadre Fireblade. That fighter may shoot twice in that shooting phase.

a397-0de7-edfb-48dd.name: The Price of Failure
a397-0de7-edfb-48dd.text: If an Ethereal is taken out of action, the Tau Pathfinder Kill Team must take a bottle test at the start of their next turn, regardless of the number of other casualties.

656d-0a10-11d2-f5eb.name: Invocation of the Elements
656d-0a10-11d2-f5eb.text: All friendly Tau Pathfinder fighters that can draw line of sight to an Ethereal automatically recover from pinning at the start of your turn.

b454-8b8d-afa2-3298.name: Shield Generator
b454-8b8d-afa2-3298.text: An Ethereal has a 4+ invulnerable save.

7e52-5d9f-3fa9-88a9.name: Bounty
7e52-5d9f-3fa9-88a9.text: If an Ethereal is down or out of action at the end of a mission, the enemy kill team secures an additional promethium cache.

0865-8dee-4317-822a.name: Large Blast
0865-8dee-4317-822a.text: A barbed strangler’s vicious tendrils spear out over a large area, and so uses the large blast template.

ac01-4957-2c9c-7c9f.name: Living Ammunition
ac01-4957-2c9c-7c9f.text: You can re-roll failed To Wound rolls for shots fired with this weapon.

368b-e7a4-ff65-71d1.name: Paired
368b-e7a4-ff65-71d1.text: A fighter attacking with two boneswords can re-roll To Wound rolls in the hand-to-hand phase.

1ae9-3456-8c6d-ffb3.name: Entangling Lash
1ae9-3456-8c6d-ffb3.text: You can force one enemy model in handto-hand combat with this model to roll one less Attack dice (to a minimum of 1).

12cb-494d-8cfa-9f68.name: Paired
12cb-494d-8cfa-9f68.text: A fighter attacking with two boneswords can re-roll To Wound rolls in the hand-to-hand phase.

7d7d-581a-e649-019b.name: Scything Strikes
7d7d-581a-e649-019b.text: A fighter with two pairs of scything talons adds 1 to its Weapon Skill in hand-to-hand combat. A fighter with three pairs of scything talons adds 2 to its Weapon Skill in hand-to-hand combat instead.

881d-4b50-9376-6823.name: Blast
881d-4b50-9376-6823.text: A Warp Blast’s burst attack disperses its energy over a wider area, and so uses the small blast template.

8a5f-eb92-2fd5-79cb.name: Psychic power
8a5f-eb92-2fd5-79cb.text: In the shooting phase, a Zoanthrope can attempt to unleash a Warp Blast. To do so, it must first pass a Leadership test. If the test is passed, pick one of the two profiles shown below and resolve the attack as if the Zoanthrope were firing a ranged weapon. If the test is failed, it cannot unleash a Warp Blast this turn. However, if you roll a double 6 for this test, the Zoanthrope also suffers a wound with no saving throws of any kind allowed.

4b69-06a4-406b-2fb3.name: Warp Field (Psychic Ability)
4b69-06a4-406b-2fb3.text: Psychic Power - May need a Leadship check, waiting on FAQ

a5ba-be49-05e4-51ec.name: Instinctive Behaviour
a5ba-be49-05e4-51ec.text: Raveners only benefit from the Synapse Creature special rule whilst they are within 12" of a friendly fighter from a Tyranid Warrior kill team (excluding other Raveners). If, at the start of your turn, a Ravener is not within synapse range, the only action it can make is to charge the nearest enemy fighter. If it makes it into hand-to-hand combat, it may fight as normal, but may otherwise perform no other actions that turn.

1225-e3d0-279c-ae4b.name: Burrow
1225-e3d0-279c-ae4b.text: Once both kill teams have been set up, but before a mission begins, you may make three free run moves with this fighter. They may not do anything during these moves except run, and must remain at ground level at all times when they do so. They also may not move within 8" of an enemy.

7105-2311-c2ae-2e62.name: Levitation
7105-2311-c2ae-2e62.text: A Zoanthrope cannot hide, but it treats all terrain as open ground for the purposes of movement. However, it cannot end its move on impassable terrain.

0778-aae5-88b7-26be.name: Bounty
0778-aae5-88b7-26be.text: If a Zoanthrope is down or out of action at the end of a mission, the enemy kill team secures an additional promethium cache.

22cd-549c-55e5-b0fe.name: hand-to-hand combat
22cd-549c-55e5-b0fe.text: In hand-to-hand combat, it counts as being equipped with a knife, but is always encumbered.

d548-eaef-e87d-3d95.name: Apex Strain
d548-eaef-e87d-3d95.text: All friendly fighters from a Tyranid Warrior kill team (but not special operatives) within 6" of a Tyranid Prime use its Weapon Skill and Ballistic Skill rather than their own, unless theirs is higher.

36d1-3327-24ba-4110.name: Combat Master
36d1-3327-24ba-4110.text: If a Tyranid Prime is attacked by multiple opponents in hand-to-hand combat, it uses their numbers against them. The enemy fighters don’t gain the multiple combat bonuses to their Attacks and Combat Score.

df9f-a14e-2115-bc23.name: Premium Bounty
df9f-a14e-2115-bc23.text: If a Tyranid Prime is down or out of action at the end of a mission, the enemy kill team secures D3 additional promethium caches.

kids.name: Power armour, frag and krak grenades, and jump pack

9140-60e8-3981-a763.name: Power armour, frag and krak grenades, and jump pack

2794-3a1e-07ab-4cdc.name: Missile Launcher - Both Frag and Super krak missiles
